label: prop:qbeta-delta-tau-surrogate-taylor-coefficients
title: Catalogue: Taylor coefficients of $\Delta\mathrm{tr}_M^{\text{surr}}$ at $q = 1$, orders 0..7
html:
Proposition. Catalogue: Taylor coefficients of \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M^{\text{surr}} at q = 1, orders 0..7

Catalogue (Taylor coefficients of the surrogate \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M). The Taylor coefficients c_n of delta_tau_M_surrogate expanded around the classical point q = 1 in the variable w = q - 1, to order 7, are read off the closed form

  \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M^{\text{surr}}(q) = \frac{
    2q^{17} - 2q^{16} - 5q^{15} + 4q^{14} + 8q^{13} - 9q^{12} - 8q^{11}
    + 9q^{10} + 11q^{9} - 11q^{8} - 9q^{7} + 8q^{6} + 9q^{5} - 8q^{4}
    - 4q^{3} + 5q^{2} + 2q - 2
  }{4 q^{8} (q^2 + q + 1)}

by substituting q = 1 + w and extracting the coefficient of w^n:

Order n Coefficient c_n Status in Lean
0 0 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_vanish_at_one)
1 -5/6 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_hasDerivAt_one)
2 5/6 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_2)
3 -23/9 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_3)
4 77/18 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_4)
5 1349/108 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_5)
6 -191/4 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_6)
7 26285/162 proved sorry-free (delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_coeff_7)

Every order is now formally proved, orders 2 and 3 by explicit quotient-rule derivative towers and orders 4 to 7 by an iterated-Leibniz recurrence on the polynomial identity f \cdot D = N. The witness independently reproduces all eight coefficients by direct series expansion, which shares no machinery with the Lean route.

Dependence on the intra-nucleon ordering. The closed form above is the one induced by the canonical borromean \chi_{(2,1)}; the grouped ordering gives (-q^{11} + q^{10} - 2q^9 + q^8 + q^6 - q^5 - q^3 + 2q^2 - q + 1)/(4q^5(q^2+q+1)) and hence c_3 = -41/9, c_4 = 149/18, c_5 = -1729/108, c_6 = 111/4, c_7 = -3665/81. Orders 0, 1 and 2 are the same in both frames, which is the load-bearing fact: the classical-point vanishing, the (q^2-1) factor and the first two Taylor data all survive the reordering, and only orders 3 and above move.
